title: Joint-fundraising transfer recipient resolution — depth 2
summary: Resolve each selected JFC's Schedule B transfers and recipient committees' Schedule A Line 12 entries to exact dated, amount-specific edges.

provenance.method: breadth-first target selection from official FEC records

workflow.next_action: Extract Form 3X Line 22 Schedule B and recipient Schedule A Line 12 transactions for the selected JFCs.

notes: FEC guidance distinguishes gross original-contributor memo entries from net transfers after allocated fundraising costs.

data.research_question: Which exact committees received transfers from the selected JFCs, on what dates, in what amounts, and how do the receiving filings reconcile the gross contributor shares and net proceeds?
objectives: Extract JFC Form 3X Line 22 and Schedule B transfers.
Match recipient committee IDs, dates, and amounts.
Reconcile recipient Schedule A Line 12 entries and original-contributor memo entries.
Separate gross contributions, allocated expenses, and net transfers.
hypotheses: Itemized transfer filings will identify exact recipient committees and dates.
Cross-filing reconciliation will distinguish summary totals from participant-specific net proceeds.
